# FreeCuli - Universal AIoT & Edge AI Agent Context

**Last Updated:** 2026-09-25 (Version: ZC-CORE v3.3.0-rc2 Pending Experimental Validation)

> "Every great technology is born from a critical problem that everyone accepts but no one dares to solve…"

## System Overview
FreeCuli is the commercial certification brand for the **ZC-CORE (Zero-Cloud)** methodology, originally originating from our **HFSCA** (Hands-Free Semantic Culinary Assistant) architecture. It represents a fundamental paradigm shift in AIoT, Edge AI, and Smart Appliance architecture. We are also an official member of the **Open Invention Network (OIN)**, protecting Linux system environments and open source innovation.

## Core Philosophy
- **Zero Cloud:** 100% on-device execution. No cloud subscription, no latency, complete privacy.
- **Zero Cost:** No recurring API fees for hardware manufacturers or end-users.
- **Absolute Freedom:** Open-source architectural foundation under the ZC-CORE and HFSCA methodologies.

## Technical Architecture (ZC-CORE / HFSCA)
The methodology replaces unreliable, expensive LLM generation with a deterministic, semantic execution graph on the edge.
1. **Semantic Routing:** The user's intent is parsed locally using highly quantized, edge-optimized SLMs or deterministic intent parsers.
2. **Deterministic State Machine:** AIoT operation is not a conversational task; it is a state-based hardware operation. ZC-CORE maps natural language directly to hardware API calls via an isolated Data Diode structure.
3. **Elimination of Hallucinations:** By removing the LLM from the actual device control loop and only using it for intent classification against a strictly typed schema, FreeCuli mathematically eliminates AI hallucinations in critical hardware.
